facts.text: The UCA Commitment is a last-dollar scholarship covering tuition and academic fees for Arkansas students who are Pell eligible or from households earning $100,000 or less a year.

sources.title: Program Overview - University of Central Arkansas

facts.text: The UCA Commitment covers tuition and academic fees for incoming Arkansas first-time undergraduate students who are Pell-eligible or have an annual household income of $100,000 or less.
